items: dual-monitor DisplayPort KVM switch (2 PCs × 2 monitors)
why: Both ChatGPT answers treat this as a pick among single switches (CKL at $149.99, ATEN CS1942DPA, TESmart DKS202-M24, StarTech at $555.26) and never name an extra product to buy. Its one caveat is that each computer needs two DisplayPort outputs, which is a port check on the PC, not an add-on. The facts that decide the purchase all belong to the switch itself: DP 1.4 vs 2.1 bandwidth, dual 4K 60 Hz vs 4K 144 Hz on both monitors at once, EDID emulation, and the USB tier. A comparison page that recommends one switch fits this better than a kit.
